# iPrice Philippines

> > iPrice Philippines is a comprehensive price comparison and deals platform featuring discounts on travel, shopping, sports gear, and beauty products from major retailers like Shopee, Lazada, Nike, Klook, AirAsia, and Booking.com.

iPrice PH helps Filipino consumers find the best deals, promo codes, and price comparisons across e-commerce platforms, travel bookings, and product categories. The platform aggregates weekly exclusive offers, seasonal sales, and limited-time vouchers to maximize savings for Philippine shoppers.
